Each object has title (string), url (string) and author (string or null). Output (no whitespace or newlines anywhere between tags): 1. Always output a wrapper
...
. 2. Heading: strip leading and trailing whitespace from heading; null counts as empty. If the result is non-empty, the first child is

HEADING

using the stripped value. Otherwise output no h2. 3. If articles is empty, output

No articles yet.

after the (optional) heading, and no ul. 4. Otherwise output
    . It holds one
  • per article, in input order. Each li contains, in this order: -

    TITLE

    - Only when show_author is true AND the author, stripped of whitespace, is non-empty (null counts as empty):

Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/featured-blog-escaping.liquid.
